title: Remotion skills: this channel is made with it
musicPrompt: Sleek, minimal launch-film electronic bed for a 60-second tech short, about 110 BPM, soft synth pulses, airy pads, light clicky percussion, calm and confident, a small lift around the trick at 30 seconds and a calm resolve into the end card, instrumental, no vocals.

scenes.text: Every video on this channel was written by Claude, in code. No editing app.
Welcome to Claude Skills, by Curiously.
Behind them are Remotion's own skills, made by the Remotion team.
With them, Claude builds a whole city, street by street.
A little workshop that acts out an idea.
Numbers that count up on the right word.
And code windows, like the ones in this video.
The trick: the skills write code Remotion Studio can edit by hand. Drag a line, move a keyframe, and it saves the change back into your code.
The catch: you need Node and a Remotion project, and companies over three people need a paid Remotion licence.
Making videos with Claude? It's one command. Link in the description.
If you like this kind of content, like, share and follow Curiously.
